description: Ctrl+H on a Sales voucher offers a REAL 'Item Invoice' (not 'Item Invoice — not built'), and choosing it TAKES EFFECT in one keystroke: the overlay closes and the frame is in item-invoice mode. This is the case that would have caught the two-year-old dead end where the picker rendered three labels and did nothing with any of them — the overlay opening is not evidence that the mode changed, so the case asserts the closed overlay AND the resulting config.
